notes.demonio_note: the 80 Devil Jin moves in demonio.json are indexed ONLY under demonio-winged:: (matched by source id); see deletion-report re_attributed
notes.exclusions_note: inputs are the 128 fighters in the loader index only; excluded: 26 bf-* stubs, 11 t7-* kits, 31 ur-char* banks, 4 non-moveset files, and the t7/ overlay dir
notes.frames_note: frames are Math.round(seconds * 60) per component; total is the sum of the rounded components, null when any component is null
notes.layer_note: layer is the ~t8/~t7/~t3/~donor suffix (or leading t7./t8./donor. marker, or __main/_c36/_t8); _r<N> row-disambiguation suffixes are NOT layers
notes.loader_stale_note: counts are computed from the moveset files, never from game/assets/movesets/index.json, whose counts are stale for 7 fighters (cainelias, charger, megami, ryuji, ryuji-rock, thor, vainabel)
notes.other_games_note: moves whose anim_ref game has no source label in the PLAN table carry source [WH] (the msSrc fallback) with the true game in source_game_label: kofxv 483, samsho 48, ttt2 34, mk 7; adding KOF/SAMSHO/TTT2/MK labels is a follow-up decision
notes.per_source_note: a move counts under each layer label it carries; per_source values do not sum to total_moves
notes.position_mapping: position is the schema enum; WS. maps to crouching (rising, approximation); stance and soul-state prefixes map to standing with the exact prefix kept in resolver_position; (back to wall)/(backtowall) map to corner
notes.quarantine_note: quarantined counts the quarantine array (Q1-Q5). Q6 unmapped-anim moves are flagged in moves with anim_status + assignable null and are NOT in the quarantine array (owner call owed, EDITOR-SPEC section 6d.1)
notes.schema_deviation: source is an array of labels per EDITOR-SPEC section 4d (a move may carry several layers); schema.json v1 declares string
notes.source_fallback_note: a move with no discriminator at all carries source [WH], matching msSrc's final else in moveset-editor-ui.js
notes.t3_source_note: T3 requires a Tekken 3 bank in t3_source; sfv/sf6/sf4 values in that slot label SF, not T3
notes.throw_definition: per_move_class.throw counts the runtime grab set (isGrab true OR move_class throw, fighter.js:449-453); other classes count by move_class value
notes.type_mapping: type = move_class when it is in the schema enum (strike, throw, special, stance, transition, grapple, hold, aerial, counter, taunt); otherwise type = special with the real move_class preserved in move_class + subtype (string/signature/parry/launcher/reversal/movement/super/unblockable/projectile/null)

honesty: estimated fields are flagged per-entry in provenance.estimated; nothing is invented as canon.
